main_text.head: LIII. LEGATI LITTERÆ Ad Varios PRINCIPES.
main_text.p: SSerenissimi Regis Navarreni jussu perfunctus sum hactenus Lega-tione apud Serenissimam Reginam Angliæ,

page.notes: The drop capital S of the final paragraph is large and joined to the word "Serenissimi". The word "Angliæ," at the end is partly blurred and its last letters are uncertain. Scattered specks and stains on the scan were left out.
